1.title: Comey Seeks Dismissal of Charges Accusing Him of Threatening Trump
1.summary: The filing focused on the question of whether a photograph of seashells arranged to read “86 47” constituted a true threat under federal law.

2.title: Bryan Kohberger, Convicted in Idaho College Killings, Seeks to Take Back Guilty Plea
2.summary: In an interview from prison, Bryan Kohberger said he had filed a petition to reopen the case. He blamed his guilty plea on “false promises” and wrong information.

3.title: How a bridge became a symbol of US-Canada tensions
3.summary: The Gordie Howe International Bridge has officially opened to motorists amid a trade row between both countries.

4.title: Wildfires Live Updates: New Heat Wave Could Worsen France and Spain’s ‘Unprecedented’ Fire Season
4.summary: Firefighters and volunteers raced to contain wildfires on Monday. The crisis has forced hundreds of thousands to evacuate in central Spain and southwest France.

5.title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ Protesters Disperse, But Questions Remain on Education and Dissent
5.summary: The ‘Cockroach’ movement dispersed, saying its demands had been met, but there are larger issues about the country’s education system and the future of dissent.

6.title: Cuba, Lacking Fuel, Relies on Ingenuity to Defy Trump’s Blockade
6.summary: President Trump has tried to strangle Cuba by blocking its oil imports. But six months later, the island is finding ways to endure.
